name: thought-line
title: Thought Line
description: A small inline status line for an AI assistant's reasoning: a sparkle, a shimmering label, a running timer and an expandable list of steps. When the work ends it folds into one line reading "Thought for 3.9s".
use: An AI chat needs to show progress and intermediate reasoning without pushing the answer down the page.
avoid: It only suits streaming agent work; with no steps the header is a plain timer with nothing to expand.
a11y: The header is a live status with a working toggle, but there is no visible focus ring and steps are plain text. (keyboard: partial, labels: partial, reduced motion: respected)
looks: A thin line of small white text on black: sparkle icon, "Thinking…", a seconds counter and a chevron, with a left-indented list of grey steps beneath, each marked by a tick or a small pulsing dot.
behaves: The timer climbs every tenth of a second while the label shimmers and steps drop in one by one. Finished steps become ticks, and when work ends the header swaps to "Thought for" and the list collapses.
customise: Steps array, working flag, labels, glyph, colours, font size, shimmer, collapse behaviour, timer visibility and a settle callback are props.
weight: light: A tenth-second timer, a shimmer and small CSS transitions; no loop when settled.
